name: Musinsa Beauty
what: Big beauty store with a wide niche perfume wall (Korean and international).

name: Seongsu-dong and Hannam-dong
what: Neighbourhoods with flagship stores: Postes, Kinfolk Notes, Tamburins, SW19, Nonfiction, Granhand.

name: Shilla Duty Free (online)
what: Duty-free online shop carrying many Korean niche lines.

name: CentralWorld, ICONSIAM, Central Ladprao
what: Malls with BOROM counters and other Thai houses.

name: Beautrium
what: Thai beauty chain with exclusive budget perfumes and Gulf brands like Ajmal.

name: Karmakamet Scentorium (Erawan Bangkok)
what: Free scent museum with hundreds of smells; book ahead.

name: Nose Shop
what: The best place to find Japanese indie perfumers.

name: Rossmann
what: Drugstore with affordable hair and body mists like Milky Mane.

name: Sukoshi and Well.ca
what: Canadian shops selling Korean mists and hair perfumes in CAD.

name: Arab Street, Kampong Glam
what: Old attar and oil shops next to modern perfumers like Sifr Aromatics.

name: 30ml, H Parfums, La Maison Générale
what: Niche shops carrying Montreal indies like Universal Flowering and Miskeo.

name: Diptyque, 34 boulevard Saint-Germain
what: Diptyque's original 1961 shop.

name: Le Marais and Palais-Royal
what: Serge Lutens, Buly 1803, État Libre d'Orange and many niche boutiques within walking distance.

name: Officina di Santa Maria Novella, Via della Scala
what: The historic monastery pharmacy, open to visitors.

name: Covent Garden and Burlington Arcade
what: Floral Street, Penhaligon's, Miller Harris and more.

name: Olive Young Myeongdong Town
what: Korea's biggest beauty chain; its flagship has a large perfume wall with try-me testers of Korean and global brands.

name: Parfumarija
what: Dublin's niche perfume boutique, run by a Grasse-trained perfumer; rare scents and custom blends at 25 Westbury Mall.

name: Cloon Keen Dublin
what: The Galway house's Dublin shop inside Powerscourt Townhouse, off Grafton Street.

name: Beleco Boom (online, Ireland)
what: Irish online shop for budget Arabian perfumes and oils, decants and discovery sets (e.g. Le Chameau Parisian Dream d'Or €19.99, Emper Ylang 62 €26.99, Emper Chic €24.99). Free delivery over €65. Prices seen on its site.

name: Qingzhi (青稚)
what: Personalised hand-care and fragrance-gift shop (not a custom-perfume atelier). Its official JD store lists Shanghai illustrated and Bund-collection hand creams, birthday-flower products and personalised gifts; visitors report gold skyline tins with engraving (scents like tuberose magnolia). No Beijing store, per visitors. Address not confirmed (per Nitah's verification check, 3 Nov 2026).

name: Anfulu (安福路, online)
what: Chinese luxury retail platform with a fragrance section carrying Chasense, Melt Season, Chujian, DOCUMENTS, To Summer, toDefine and Lavas, plus a wholesale and distribution contact. Useful for cross-checking Chinese perfume names, perfumers, sizes and prices (per Nitah's verification check, 3 Nov 2026).
